title: specaudit custody journal record (v1)
description: One authenticated custody/replay record over a reader observation. The HMAC key is an operator-chosen local trust root; nothing here claims an operator provisioned or used it. custody_state is strictly limited to operator-asserted-custody and verified-custody: source-authenticity is an open operator gate that this journal cannot claim locally. The acquisition digest binds the acquisition record's content-identity fields (size_bytes, sha256) so retained artifact bytes can be re-verified; the full observation document lives outside the journal.

journal_id.description: derived from the attempt identity; one journal serves one attempt

observation_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical reader-observation.v1 document, which lives outside the journal

acquisition_digest.description: sha256 over the canonical AcquisitionRecord content-identity fields

recorded_at.description: naive local iso datetime supplied by the caller

auth_tag.description: optional HMAC-SHA256 under the operator-held key, over the canonical record bytes including record_digest
